# Apps by Adam

> Apps by Adam builds simple apps for creators and small businesses: an app for every problem.

## Pages

- [Your app plan in 60 seconds · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/app-plan/): Answer 5 questions and get a free one-page plan for your first app: what it does, its 3 screens, a build prompt and today's task.
- [Build notes · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/blog/): Weekly build notes: one problem, the app that solves it, and what broke.
- [Bopumi: turn an idea into a project board · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/bopumi/): Turns an idea into a clear project board.
- [Camp Connect: run a church youth camp · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/camp-connect/): Helps churches run youth camp: sign-ups, schedules, messages and payments.
- [Curatelume: organize your marketing photos · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/curatelume/): A neat home for all your pictures and videos for marketing.
- [Daymori: plan your whole day · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/daymori/): An AI planner that builds your day for you.
- [Demoforge: turn screenshots into demo videos · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/demoforge/): Turns app screenshots into slick 3D demo videos.
- [Funnelume: build sales pages with video · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/funnelume/): Builds sales pages with video built in.
- [FurnitureFlow: flip furniture for profit · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/furnitureflow/): Runs a furniture flipping business.
- [Goldforge: find a good app idea · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/goldforge/): Helps you find a good app idea and plan it from start to finish.
- [HookToTake: remix videos that already work · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/hooktotake/): Shows short videos that are doing well, then helps you make your own version.
- [Apps by Adam: an app for every problem](https://appsbyadam.app/): Adam builds an app for every problem, with AI, in public. See the apps you can use today and the ones being built.
- [Launchloom: write and sell an ebook · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/launchloom/): Helps you pick a topic, write an ebook, sell it on a simple page, and post about it.
- [Leadmorrow: find local businesses to sell to · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/leadmorrow/): Finds local businesses to sell to and writes the outreach.
- [Orvelume: plan your ads · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/orvelume/): Helps plan ads: what to say, who to show them to, and what happens next.
- [Playlume: turn video viewers into leads · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/playlume/): Hosts your videos and turns viewers into leads.
- [Podcast Studio: run a podcast from plan to paycheck · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/podcast-studio/): One place for podcasters to plan, make, grow and earn from their show. New name coming.
- [Screen Designer: design app screens · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/screen-designer/): AI that designs app screens for you. New name coming.
- [Scripture Scholar: play Bible trivia · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/scripture-scholar/): A Bible trivia game that never ends.
- [Setivra: answer new leads and book calls · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/setivra/): An AI chat helper that talks to new leads, books calls and follows up.
- [SneakerFlow: price sneakers before you resell · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/sneakerflow/): Checks what an item sells for on eBay, Poshmark, Mercari and StockX.
- [Traction Desk: get a marketing move every day · Apps by Adam](https://appsbyadam.app/traction-desk/): Writes marketing ideas for each app every day. You say yes or no. It never posts.
